answer: Because the derivation is bound to the mesa signature, the mirror gate rejects a mismatch, and the pearl checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. A bank of pre-written answers hence has nothing to key against, and filling 44 aliases means authoring 44 texts that each match their own nonce. Each challenge carries a 60 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
